exposure: Duration of participation in surveillance program
outcome: Positive predictive value of SSI identification
Negative predictive value of SSI identification
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 147 hospitals or hospital units with surgical activities in Switzerland, from which a random sample of 15 patient records per hospital was reviewed.
finding: The study revealed a wide variation in SSI surveillance quality across Swiss hospitals, with a median validation score of 35.5 out of 50, and identified quality of chart review and data extraction as the main areas for improvement.
cross-section timing: Data collection and site visits were conducted around 2017.
